Shared value types for the ogimage library.

OgImage is the single input object: content plus presentation. Rendering lives in ogimage/render; presets in ogimage/theme.

spans

Types

OgBackground = object
  case kind*: OgBackgroundKind
  of bgSolid:
    color*: Color
  of bgGradient:
    fromColor*: Color
    toColor*: Color
    angleDeg*: float64
  of bgImage:
    path*: string
    tint*: Color
    overlayAlpha*: float64
    overlayAngleDeg*: float64 ## Direction of the scrim gradient, in degrees (-90.0 =
                              ## opaque at the bottom behind the description/footer,
                              ## fading to transparent at the top). Same convention as
                              ## `angleDeg`.
    fit*: OgBgFit
    pos*: OgBgPos
Explicit background override. When kind is bgImage but path is empty or undecodable, render falls back to the preset solid. 
OgBackgroundKind = enum
  bgSolid, bgGradient, bgImage
OgBgFit = enum
  bgCover,                  ## Scale to fill the canvas, cropping overflow
                             ## (CSS `background-size: cover`).
  bgContain, ## Scale to fit inside the canvas, letterboxing on the
              ## preset page color (CSS `background-size: contain`).
  bgFill                     ## Stretch to the exact canvas size, ignoring aspect ratio.
OgBgPos = object
  case centered*: bool
  of true:
    nil
  of false:
    x*: float64
    y*: float64
Where to place the background image. Either centered on both axes (center center) or an explicit top-left origin in user units (px px). 
OgContent = object
  title*: string
  description*: string
  titleSegs*: seq[OgSeg]     ## Rich title runs; when non-empty these win over `title`.
  descSegs*: seq[OgSeg] ## Rich description runs; when non-empty these win over
                        ## `description`.
  badge*: string             ## Small pill above the title. Empty hides it.
  site*: string ## Plain footer label, e.g. "nimbase.dev". Empty hides it.
                ## Ignored when `footer` items are set.
  footer*: seq[OgFooterItem] ## Bottom-row icon + label items (handles, counters, captions)
                             ## laid out as one NVG flex row. Empty falls back to `site`.
  logoPath*: string ## Optional square-ish logo drawn in the top-right corner.
                    ## Empty skips it, as does a set `photoPath` (the photo owns
                    ## the right side).
  photoPath*: string ## Optional photo drawn as a `photoRadius` rounded square avatar
                     ## sharing the headline row (like a profile pic). The
                     ## description below keeps the full width. Empty or
                     ## undecodable paths fall back to the full-width layout.
OgError = object of CatchableError
OgFooterItem = object
  iconDark*: string          ## Icon raster for dark presets; "" draws the label alone.
  iconLight*: string         ## Icon raster for light presets; "" falls back to `iconDark`.
  label*: string
One bottom-row item: an optional icon plus its label (handle, counter, caption — e.g. "@nimbase/ogimage", "1.2k", "MIT"). Any raster icon works; the dark/light paths pick the variant for the preset brightness. 
OgImage = object
  width*: int
  height*: int
  content*: OgContent
  background*: OgBackground
  hasBackground*: bool       ## When false the preset default background is used.
  preset*: OgPreset
  accent*: Color
  hasAccent*: bool           ## When false the preset default accent is used.
  align*: TextHAlign
  hasAlign*: bool ## When true, overrides the preset alignment (e.g. `thaRight`
                  ## for RTL text). Otherwise the preset alignment is used.
  scale*: float64 ## Output scale factor (1.0 = 1200x630 px, 2.0 = retina
                  ## 2400x1260 px). Layout stays in `width`x`height` user units.
                  ## Values <= 0 fall back to 1.0.
  fontTitlePath*: string     ## Empty resolves via `resolveTitleFont`.
  fontBodyPath*: string      ## Empty falls back to the title font.
  fontStrongPath*: string ## Bold face for `strong` segments. Empty falls back to the
                          ## layout font (a no-op when the base face is already bold).
  fontEmPath*: string ## Italic face for `em` segments. Empty falls back to the
                      ## layout font. A bold-italic file here also covers
                      ## `strong(em(...))` runs.
  strongFaceIndex*: int
  emFaceIndex*: int
  fallbackFontPaths*: seq[string] ## Optional fallback faces for glyphs missing from the title
                                  ## or body font. Tried in order; unknown files are skipped.
                                  ## Same-direction scripts only: mixed-direction text (e.g.
                                  ## Hebrew + Latin) needs a single covering font instead, since
                                  ## fallback runs shape in logical order.
  titleFaceIndex*: int
  bodyFaceIndex*: int
OgPreset = enum
  opDark,                   ## Dark card, light text, accent bar.
  opLight,                  ## White card, dark ink.
  opGradient,               ## Full-bleed brand gradient, white ink.
  opPhoto,                  ## Background photo with a dark overlay, white ink.
  opMinimal,                ## Centered, quiet, thin divider instead of an accent bar.
  opBrand                    ## Accent-driven gradient, white ink, centered.
OgTheme = object
  titleSize*: float64
  descSize*: float64
  badgeSize*: float64
  siteSize*: float64
  onDark*: bool ## True when the preset background is dark (picks the light
                ## repo icon variant).
  titleColor*: Color
  descColor*: Color
  badgeBg*: Color
  badgeColor*: Color
  siteColor*: Color
  pageBg*: Color             ## Fallback page color under photos/gradients.
  accent*: Color
  align*: TextHAlign
  padding*: float64
  radius*: float64
  titleMaxLines*: int
  descMaxLines*: int
  centered*: bool
Resolved drawing parameters for one render. Build with themeForPreset; fields are fixed sizes because body text uses ellipsis, never auto-shrink.

proc imageBackground(path: string; overlayAlpha = 0.55; tint = rgbf(0, 0, 0)): OgBackground {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Cover-fit, centered, with a vertical scrim gradient (#000 at overlayAlpha at the bottom fading to transparent) between the photo and the text. For full control use imageBackgroundEx. 
proc imageBackgroundEx(path: string; fit = bgCover; pos = bgPosCenter();
                       overlayAlpha = 0.55; tint = rgbf(0, 0, 0);
                       overlayAngleDeg = -90.0): OgBackground {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Full background-image control: fit selects cover (fill + crop), contain (fit inside + letterbox), or fill (stretch); pos is bgPosCenter() or bgPosPx(x, y); the scrim runs from tint at overlayAlpha to transparent along overlayAngleDeg (-90.0 = opaque bottom, transparent top).
